description: Starting 17:03 UTC, shipping-service returned errors for 17 minutes and 4 services were degraded or down. Find what started the outage and how the failure spread.

changes.what: feat: expose build info on /version
refactor: extract config loader into its own package
Temporarily raise log level for a support ticket
Reduce paging noise on p99 alert
feat: add request id to access logs
fix: correct typo in validation error
Lengthen cache TTL for catalogue pages
chore: bump logging library to 2.4.1
Enable new dashboard for internal users
Kernel patch applied to batch nodes during the maintenance window.
test: cover retry backoff jitter
TTL lowered to 60s for the internal zone. Completed.
Scale out ahead of the weekend campaign
fix: tighten client retry budget
Autoscaler added 2 nodes to the general pool.
TLS certificate rotated for *.internal. Completed.
ci: pin base image digest
chore: remove unused feature flag for legacy onboarding
fix: handle empty page token in list endpoint
Sample more traces while debugging checkout
perf: sort export rows in memory before streaming
docs: update runbook links
